recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a woman with warm, golden skin tones, wearing a red knit beanie and braids. The composition features a high-contrast lighting scheme that emphasizes facial contours, paired with contrasting typographic styles at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against a deep red textile texture
Hand-drawn expressive script vs. clean geometric sans-serif
Extreme facial proximity creating an intimate viewer connection
coreInvariants: Tight cropping that cuts off the top of the head and sides of the face
Warm, amber-hued lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 90% of the frame, centered horizontally with the eyes positioned in the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the highlight in the iris, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the expressive script at the top, down through the bridge of the nose to the lips, ending at the geometric text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the dark areas between the braids and the edges of the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and warm tones; high value contrast between the white text and dark background elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Hybrid of gestural script and geometric modernism
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Variable stroke width, sharp terminals, elongated horizontal crossbars that extend beyond the letter boundaries.
Bottom text: Uniform thin stroke, perfectly circular counters, lowercase only, tight kerning.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' in the top text features a crossbar that extends into a long horizontal underline.
The 'w' in the bottom text is constructed from two overlapping 'u' shapes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic top text paired with disciplined, geometric bottom text for a balance of personality and structure.
graphicDevices: Horizontal strike-through/underline element in the top text

preserve: Circular counters in the bottom text
Hand-drawn feel of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, circular nature of the bottom text.
To replicate the raw, gestural quality of the top display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-detail, extreme close-up photograph of a woman with warm skin, dark eyes, and braids, wearing a textured red knit beanie. Lighting should be warm and directional, creating soft shadows on the face. The crop should be tight, focusing on the eyes, nose, and lips.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the display text in a white, hand-drawn marker style at the top, ensuring the 'A' has a long horizontal tail. Add the subtitle in a white, thin geometric sans-serif at the bottom, using lowercase letters with circular forms.

verificationChecks: Is the skin tone warm and golden?
Is the top text gestural and the bottom text geometric?
Is the crop tight enough to eliminate most background detail?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red in the beanie
Thickness of the geometric font strokes
Degree of 'hand-drawn' irregularity in the top script
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or titles
Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is pure white and stands out against the image.
Check that the knit texture of the beanie is visible.
Verify the geometric 'o' and 'b' shapes are perfectly circular.
Confirm the lighting feels warm and soulful.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + Warm amber lighting + Red textile accent + (Gestural Script Top / Geometric Sans Bottom) white typography.
